name: House Flag
description:
FEATURES

  • Best material: The garden flag is made of sturdy all-weather polyester, double layer stitching and reinforced corners improve durability. Water & UV resistant material extends the life of this flag and helps maintain its bright colors. Quality craftsmanship goes into every flag which has double sewn edges to prevent fraying.
  • Fabric: 100% Polyester
  • GSM: Approximately 100g/m2
  • Perfect Design:The flag has a sleeve on top that will allow the flag to slide onto a flag stand. Flag stand sold separately. It is truly double-sided printed. The pattern is available in both sides and you don't need to rotate the flag blown back by the wind. Double burlap stitched together greatly enhance the durability of the summer yard flag.
  • Widely Usage: Great outdoor decoration for new homeowners, avid gardeners, home decoration and outdoors enthusiasts to display on their patio, porch ,veranda, lawn, garden or backyard.
  • Customization: We make garden flag on demand, so give us your design to create your one-of-a-kind garden flag. Creative 3D print will make your garden brighten and outstanding.
  • Gift of Love: A meaningful gift for your friends, family members, wife/husband, bridesmaid/groomsmen, coworkers, neighbors on birthday, Mother's day, Father’s Day, wedding, anniversary, Christmas, engagement, Thanksgiving day, Valentine's day. A wonderful way to honor the memory of a special person or milestone.
  • Garment Care: Hand wash in cold water (below 30 degrees), no bleach, hang dry.

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 

Download templates and mockups here

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
